title: Phase 9 Complete: Self-Documenting, Self-Improving Wheel Architecture
description: Phase 9 implements the complete architecture for a self-documenting wheel: spokes self-declare via metadata, hub aggregates on wakeup, agents navigate via help skill, gaps become lugs that improve the wheel. All documentation is living (skills + lugs), not separate files.
perceive: Wheel needs to: (1) know itself (metadata), (2) route questions accurately (registry), (3) learn from usage (help feedback loop), (4) improve over time (gaps → improvements)
execute: Implemented three core skills: self-registry (spokes self-declare), hub-registry-refresh (hub aggregates), help (agents navigate and surface gaps). All documentation in Skills + Lugs, no separate markdown files.
verify: Each spoke can maintain its own metadata. Hub gets current registry on wakeup. Agents can find answers or surface gaps. Wheel learns and improves from usage.
resolution_reason: Architecture is self-sustaining: spokes declare → hub aggregates → agents navigate → gaps improve wheel. Living documentation means nothing gets forgotten.
